layout.Description: Root element; defines the abstract layout

view.Description: Layout-specific view; only one for web environment, multiple allowed for native environments

table.Description: Container for arranging controls in rows and columns
Constraints: Match the sum of `columns` values to the container `width` value
Match the sum of `rows` values to the container `height` value
Match the number of `<row>` elements to the `rows` values count
Match the number of `<cell>` elements in each row to the `columns` values count

row.Description: Table row containing one or more cells

cell.Description: Table cell containing exactly one child control at a row/column position

canvas.Description: Container for absolute positioning of controls
Constraints: Every child requires both `width` and `height` attributes
Every child requires one of `left` or `right` attributes
Every child requires one of `top` or `bottom` attributes

stencil.Description: Container referencing an Stencil object as a component
Constraints: Encode fully qualified Stencil object name in the element tag
Define `stencil:` prefix by default; accept unprefixed tags as valid
Allow self-closing tags when no control overrides are present; otherwise use paired tags
Every override defines a direct child (flat definition); forbid hierarchical nesting
Apply dot-separated names to elements within a stencil hierarchy
Apply `data` attribute over input-based children using a local variable or attribute

matrixGrid.Description: Display data in two-dimensional grid with X and Y axes

charts.Description: Visual representation of numeric data as pie or timeline chart

horizontalGrid.Description: Displays data horizontally with automatic paging

imageGallery.Description: Displays images in table or slider view

imageMap.Description: Display background image with selectable regions

leavesGrid.Description: Visual effect of turning pages in a book

magazineViewer.Description: Displays data in a magazine format

pagedGrid.Description: Displays list of elements in pages

smartGrid.Description: Displays elements in a configurable responsive grid

sparkLine.Description: Displays high-density series of values in a compact graph

maps.Description: Display locations and geometries on a map

tabPage.Description: Container for tab content and tab item settings

group.Description: Visual grouping of controls for better usability and accessibility

input.Description: Editable or read-only input field; single or multiline depending on underlying Data Type value

checkBox.Description: Displays a check box input element

comboBox.Description: Display dynamic list of items for selecting a value

scanner.Description: Reads barcodes and QR codes into attribute or variable

calendar.Description: Displays multiple calendars for date selection

chronometer.Description: Displays chronometer on screen for timing events

facebookButton.Description: Provides Facebook user data and login functionality

multiWheel.Description: Display scrollable wheels to select values

physicalMeasure.Description: Display input in metric system for physical measures

slider.Description: Display value from a range by sliding an indicator

wheel.Description: Display scrollable wheel to select one value

toggleButtonGroup.Description: Defines toggle button group values and descriptions

animationView.Description: Displays animations in application screens and manages their behavior

adsView.Description: Displays advertisements in specified location within panel

action.Description: Group actions for dynamic display in panels

label.Description: Display text blocks with static content

image.Description: Display static image from existing Image object
Constraints: Bind static Image objects through `source` attribute exclusively
Bind variable-defined images through `data` attribute exclusively
Keep exactly one of `source` or `data` attributes; never use both

onecontent.Description: Single content area; exlusive for `WorkWithDevices` definition

component.Description: Container for `Panel` or `Work With` objects, reusable and independent

html.Description: Allows adding HTML content in web applications

simplegrid.Description: Displays data in a simple grid format

contentholder.Description: Container for other UI objects in a master-detail design

hyperlink.Description: Displays clickable link to external page

hr.Description: Display time interval using specified units

section.Description: Defines a section in Web Forms using HTML div tags

item.Description: Scrolls text or HTML in a box

attribute.Description: Attribute or variable bound to the control

advanced.Description: User can zoom and copy image

filterattribute.Description: Filters grid records based on a single condition

option.Description: Selects an option from a drop-down control

smart.Description: Container for arranging controls in two-dimensional layout
Constraints: Match the sum of `columns` values to the container `width` value
Match the sum of `rows` values to the container `height` value
Match the number of `<row>` elements to the `rows` values count
Match the number of `<cell>` elements in each row to the `columns` values count

responsive.Description: Container for arranging controls that adapts to screen size

hoverPanel.Description: Show information on mouse over elements

googleAnalytics.Description: Integrates Google Analytics features into web pages

googleAnnotatedTimeLine.Description: Interactive time series line chart with annotations

googleCharts.Description: Interactive pie chart for comparing values

googleGauge.Description: Displays numeric values as a gauge for better data visualization

googleIntensityMap.Description: Shows map highlighting regions based on relative values

googleMapControl.Description: Shows map highlighting regions based on relative values

googleMotion.Description: Dynamic chart to explore indicators over time

googleTable.Description: Display chart types including Column, Bar, Line, Pie, and Scatter

mediaPlayer.Description: Display multimedia content such as audio, video, PDF

progressIndicator.Description: Displays an indicator of a process's activity

scheduler.Description: Display chronological events by day, week or month

historyManager.Description: Allows undoing task execution in GXFlow Client

treeview.Description: Provides hierarchical data visualization with expandable nodes

tabularFlexGrid.Description: Cell expands to occupy multiple rows

form.Description: Runtime object representing the current form
Constraints: Cannot be placed in the layout; only accessed via the reserved name `Form` in event code, never instantiated
Native only supports only Caption/Refresh, Web supports all properties/methods
